In continuation with the advertisement vide letter No SRES-DID/NGP/VB-GRG/Fill/18/2026/4 Dated
Nongpoh, the 21 August 2026. Applications are invited from the residents of Meghalaya having reauisite
qualification & experience as mentioned hereunder on contractual basis under Viksit Bharat Guarantee Rozgar
Gram Aieevika Mission Gramin (VB-G-RAM-G) and Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana- Gramin (PMAY-G), Ri Bhoi
District. The eligible applicants should submit their application along with their Bio-Data, educational
qualification, the experience certificate, passport size photographs and address for communication, on or before
the 30" September, 2026 during office hours. Date of test/interview willbe intimated later. For details interested
applicants may visit the district website www.ribhoi,gov.in or check the office notice board. Incomplete
applications willbe rejected without further communication.
